# Cancer facility stays in Norwalk

## Pet specialty: Veterinary Oncology & Hematology Center adds radiation therapy to its list of services as it plans to move its offices within the city

By Richard Lee, Staff Writer Jan 17, 2011

Cookie, a 7 year-old Lhaso Apso is examined by Dr. Edwin Brodsky at the Veterinary Oncology & Hematology Center in Norwalk, Conn. on Friday, Jan. 14, 2011 for a check-up. Cookie has been cancer free for over 3 years and came in from Waterbury with her owners, Shirley and Charlie Corden for a check-up.

Cathy Zuraw

Allyson Kruzshak, CVT, VTS (Hospital Manager), Edwin Brodsky, DVM, DACVIM (Oncology) David Duchemin (Business Manager) and Gerald Post, DVM, MEM, DACVIM (Oncolgy) in an examination room at the Veterinary Oncology & Hematology Center in Norwalk, Conn. on Friday, Jan. 14, 2011.

Cathy Zuraw

Becky Malone, customer service rep. for Veterinary Oncology & Hematology Center in Norwalk, Conn. gives Lisa Wells from Monroe instructions for the care of her dog Moose, on Friday, Jan. 
Gerald Post, who has practiced in Norwalk since 1999, and his staff are moving from a 2,000-square-foot space at 178 Connecticut Ave., to 7,950 square feet at 129 Glover Ave., in Norwalk, tentatively in October.

Post, who shares oncology duties with Edwin Brodsky, medical director at the center, said he is confident that there will be a demand for the new service.

"There's such a need for it in Connecticut. It's absolutely the right time to do it. Now we'll have room for expansion," said Post, estimating the cost of the radiation unit at $200,000 and the creation of a lead-lined room to house it at another $20,000.

He will conduct a job search for technicians to operate the equipment and said he expects to double the size of his staff to 28 in two years.

## We Simplify Logistics

For patients requiring frequent evaluations and/or treatments, our mobile service simplifies logistics, improving scheduling and enhancing the overall quality of life for pets and their families. We pride ourselves on our collaborative approach, working closely with your family veterinarian or any other clinician/veterinary hospital involved in your pet’s care. This ensures a comprehensive and coordinated treatment plan.  At VCCS, we are dedicated to providing exceptional care tailored to your pet’s individual needs, ensuring comfort, convenience, and peace of mind every step of the way. Our service area covers a variety of locations in Connecticut and New York. This includes Fairfield County in Connecticut, encompassing Stamford, Darien, New Canaan, Greenwich, Norwalk, Rowayton, Westport, Fairfield, Weston, and Wilton. In Westchester County, New York, we serve Scarsdale, Armonk, Mamaroneck, Larchmont, and Yonkers. Additionally, we reach Mount Kisco, Bedford Hills, Harrison, and Pound Ridge. While we cannot directly service New York City, we’re happy to meet at a convenient nearby location to examine and/or treat your pet.

Please note: For clients outside our travel range who wish to see us, we are happy to arrange to meet at a convenient location. This is usually in Stamford, New Canaan, or Greenwich. However, we are open to other options depending on our schedule and the location of our travel each day. ×
